adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff now does `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i`, then applies them directly: `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no clamping/validation to prevent negative values. A request like `?offset=-1` will generate a negative SQL OFFSET, which PostgreSQL rejects and would surface as a 500 on this public endpoint. This pagination previously only applied to automatic groups, but the diff makes it apply to all groups, increasing reachability.
